patterns: APPSC asks single-fact attribution items: who identified Sriparvata Swamy with Buddha, which king gave greatest patronage, tutelary deity (Hariti).
Traveller traps recur: Itsing vs Fahien vs Hiuen Tsang (Suhrllekha).
Sect-centre pairs (Purvasailiya-Amaravati, Aparasailiya-Nagarjunakonda) and dynasty-deity matching are typical shapes.
App MCQs dig into inscription-level detail (pillar donors, Bodhisri's country list) far deeper than the PYQs.
